title: GarmingPlugin local server at /sgv.json endpoint returns constant tbr:0
symptom: The /sgv.json endpoint of the Garmin plugin local server always returns tbr:0 regardless of the actual temporary basal rate. For example, with a basal rate of 90, the endpoint returns 0 instead of 90.
cause: The implementation used the result of the algorithm (loop.lastRun?.constraintsProcessed) rather than the actual TBR that arrives at the pump, which can deviate from real values.
fix: Replace the temporaryBasal getter to use processedTbrEbData.getTempBasalIncludingConvertedExtended(System.currentTimeMillis())?.rate instead of apsResult.percent / 100.0. A PR was proposed and accepted.
evidence_quote: The reason was not that the function did not work, but rather the occasional deviation from the real values. Because here @buessow used the result of the algorithm, not what actually arrives at the pump.
